cards.title: Parenting Considerations for Raising Gifted Children
cards.body: Gifted and talented children present unique teaching challenges across different domains. Understanding their specific needs helps parents better support their development.

cards.title: The Dark Side of Parent Support Groups
cards.body: Well-meaning parent groups can silence expert advice and reward conformity, allowing misinformation to spread unchecked. Parents should critically evaluate group dynamics and information sources.

cards.title: Invisible Family Labor Shapes Daughterhood Too
cards.body: Women's unpaid care work extends far beyond motherhood and shapes their entire lives. This invisible labor often goes unnoticed until women stop doing it.

cards.title: Six Ways to Ease Back-to-School Transitions
cards.body: Parenting experts share practical tips for making the return to school smoother. Strategic planning helps children adjust and reduces stress for the entire family.

cards.title: My Son Is Leaving Home for University
cards.body: Empty nesting catches many parents off guard despite knowing it's coming. Acknowledging these complex emotions helps parents navigate this major life transition.

cards.title: Music Festivals With Children Add Real Magic
cards.body: Families at festivals create a different atmosphere that enhances the experience for everyone. Parents can successfully balance parenting duties with enjoying live events.
